title: Vietnamese-Style Chicken Banh Mi Tacos
description: A twist on the classic banh mi sandwich, served in a crispy taco shell with tender and flavorful chicken.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, chili sauce, and a pinch of salt. Add the sliced chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the banh mi bread in the oven or on the grill.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of grilled chicken onto each bread piece, followed by a spoonful of pickled carrots and a sprinkle of cilantro.
